title: Stolen funds moved through lending, pools, a privacy coin and mule accounts
summary: An attacker empties an exchange. The funds pass through a flash loan, liquidity pools and a privacy coin, and an exchange then pays a chain of mule accounts.

basis.note: A case follows one slice of the stolen funds. The slice is at most 25,000 pounds, which is the Faster Payments limit of a personal account in the generator, and its range is assumed.

references.note: The report describes each method separately. The library combines them as an example.

references.pages: finding 1 of the cell, on cashing out after 2 to 5 mule accounts
